meta.title: Fleet Migration — Phase A Setup
meta.description: Account setup checklist for the ArgoFleet Kingly migration: Vercel, Convex, Clerk, keys, and the cutover flow.

props.title: ArgoFleet → Kingly Migration
props.subtitle: Four account tasks on your side. Everything else is staged and waits on them.
props.meta: Plan: fleet-repo-reorg-kingly-migration · Old stack decommissions after Sat

props.content: The repo mirror is already live and the demo stack is untouched. Once the four tasks below are done, staging can be stood up end-to-end and cutover shrinks to a DNS swap.

props.label: Marine branch merged to ArgoEdge main first
Changes to Sunny's live stack (demo untouched)
YOUR FOUR TASKS
props.title: Account setup
props.subtitle: Each is a dashboard click-through. Order doesn't matter except Clerk prod, which waits on the domain call.

props.title: 1 · Vercel — repoint the project
props.content: Your existing argo-fleet project is right, with one change from the screenshot review: connect it to the new **Kingly-Agency/ArgoFleet** repo (not ArgoEdge) and clear the Root Directory field — the app now lives at repo root. vercel.json drives framework/build/output. Then pin the staging branch: Settings → Domains → add fleet-staging domain → assign to the `staging` branch. "Skip deployments" is no longer needed — the repo contains only the dashboard.

props.title: 2 · Convex — two projects
props.content: On the Argo/Kingly team create **argo-fleet-staging** and **argo-fleet** (prod). Convex has no staging concept inside a project, so staging is its own project — a real firewall between QA experiments and prod data. Note both deployment URLs (https://<name>.convex.cloud); they become the VITE_CONVEX_URL values.

props.title: 3 · Clerk — one Argo application
props.content: Create one Argo-owned Clerk application. Its **dev instance** (pk_test) exists immediately and doubles as staging auth. The **prod instance** (pk_live) needs the domain decision — fleet.argomarine.ai? — then `clerk deploy`. In BOTH instances add a JWT template named exactly `convex`. Sunny's old hobby Clerk stays as local-dev only.

props.title: 4 · Collect the secrets
props.content: Gather now, set later: **ANTHROPIC_API_KEY** (powers Ask Argo in convex/ai.ts), Sunny's hobby Clerk **pk_test** key (local dev), **VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY** (optional satellite layer), **aisstream.io** key (optional demo AIS). Send them securely to this box like ENV_MIGRATION.md — never commit.

props.label: REFERENCE
props.title: Environment matrix
props.subtitle: One Vercel project (env-scoped vars) · two Convex projects · one Clerk app.

props.label: ENV KEYS
props.title: The complete key-wiring surface
props.subtitle: Three places keys live. This is all of it — local dev needs none (npx convex dev autowrites .env.local).

props.filename: 1 — Vercel (build-time VITE_* vars, scoped per environment)
props.content:
vercel env add VITE_CONVEX_URL production        # https://<argo-fleet>.convex.cloud
vercel env add VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY production   # pk_live_...
vercel env add VITE_CONVEX_URL preview           # staging Convex URL
vercel env add VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY preview      # pk_test_...
# optional, both envs:
vercel env add VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY production

props.filename: 2 — Convex (server-side secrets, run against staging AND prod)
props.content:
npx convex env set CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN https://<your-clerk-issuer> --prod
npx convex env set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY sk-ant-...  --prod   # Ask Argo copilot
npx convex env set GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY ...           --prod   # optional
# dashboard task: JWT template named exactly 'convex' in each Clerk instance

props.filename: 3 — Boat box .env (cutover only — boats dark until re-paired)
props.content:
ARGO_FLEET_CONVEX_URL=<prod convex url>
ARGO_BOAT_ID=<boat id>
ARGO_FLEET_DEVICE_TOKEN=<re-paired against new Convex>

props.title: Silent mock mode
props.content: The app boots happily with NO backend: if either VITE_CONVEX_URL or VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is missing, it ships fake data with no auth and looks deployed. Both keys or it isn't real.

props.label: STRATEGY
props.title: Parallel stack → DNS swap
props.subtitle: No migrate-in-place. Sunny's stack stays live as instant rollback until Saturday.

props.title: Build staging
props.content: Deploy mirror to staging: Convex functions + snapshot data import + Clerk dev instance at fleet-staging.

props.title: QA in cloud mode
props.content: Real auth roundtrip, org data, maps, Ask Argo — while the demo runs untouched on Sunny's stack.

props.title: GO (after demo)
props.content: Final mirror sync · fresh data import to prod · DNS points fleet.argomarine.ai at Vercel · boat re-pairs.

props.title: Rollback
props.content: Point DNS back at Sunny's stack. Window closes Saturday at decommission.

props.title: ArgoEdge stays canonical
props.content: ALL fleet-dashboard commits go through ArgoEdge. Nobody commits to the ArgoFleet mirror directly — it refreshes one-way from ArgoEdge main. Your partner's workflow is unchanged.

props.title: Demo stack is frozen
props.content: No convex deploy, no vercel --prod, no DNS changes against the dawei-sun targets (adjoining-raven-823 / hearty-weasel-878 / argo-fleet.vercel.app) before the demo.

props.title: Clerk IDs won't survive
props.content: New Clerk instance = new user IDs. Imported member/org tables need an ID-mapping pass; with the small user count, re-inviting is the lazy correct path.
